{{Quote|The aiwha of our world hunt in pods to bring down much larger prey. So too shall you join your three brothers and become fierce hunters for the Republic. Now, join your pod.|[[Taun We/Legends|Taun We]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>}}
'''Pod''' was a general term used by [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] to describe a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who were grown, trained, and deployed as a single unit. The term came from the [[Pod (social group)|pods]] that [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]] hunted in on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

Members of the same pod were referred to as pod brothers, as was the case with the pod brother [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] [[Sev/Legends|Sev]] and [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]].
